what.text: This page follows refugees from Sudan living in Kenya, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 7383 Sudanese refugees in Kenya, 0.3% of all refugees from Sudan.
Chad hosts the most Sudanese refugees, followed by South Sudan, Libya and Ethiopia.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Sudan from 1983 to 2018 and from 2020 to 2025, at war level in most of those years, with the SPLM/A, JEM and RSF among the opponents.
It also records armed conflict over Southern Sudan territory from 1965 to 1972.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1970 at 290 refugees, and the figure was at its highest, 76646, at the end of 2005.
The main years of displacement in the data are 1995 and 1998 to 2007, and the figure was lower by 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Kenya.
These are year-end totals for Kenya only, reported to UNHCR.
